text.en: 1. These Rules are the Income Tax (Exemptions from Notification under Sections 10J(5) and 32A(4)) Rules 2022 and are deemed to have come into operation on 16 November 2021.

heading.en: Exemption of individual from sections 10J(5) and 32A(4) of Act

text.en: 2. A person who is an individual is exempt from sections 10J(5) and 32A(4) of the Act.

heading.en: Section 10J(5) of Act does not apply to certain donations

text.en: 3. Section 10J(5) of the Act does not apply in a case where a person appropriates by way of a donation any trading stock that is perishable.
